# Caraka

> A thin bridge from Telegram, Discord, or WhatsApp to the coding agent already installed on your machine. A task lives in its own topic or thread, like tabs in a terminal, and in a header where the chat app has neither. Caraka has no agent loop, no execution tools, and no plugin marketplace: the coding agent already has all of those.

Caraka speaks [ACP](https://agentclientprotocol.com), the LSP-equivalent for coding agents. Seven agent presets ship, one YAML file each, and four of them have been run here against a live binary: Claude Code on both its routes, Codex and aider on the CLI, goose over ACP. Memory ships since v0.3 through [Titen](https://titen.dev), through a local SQLite provider, or not at all; Titen separates observation, claim, and context so a conclusion is never confused with the evidence behind it.

Status: v1.3, MIT, Node ≥ 22. Every phase of the roadmap carries shipped code and not one field gate has been answered by a person: no dogfood week, no recorded setup session, no beta group, no live Discord credential, and no WhatsApp number ever linked. The npm registry holds 1.3.0.

Since v1.3 a paired room answers only when it is addressed — a mention, a reply, or a command — and a channel that cannot report addressing is answered anyway rather than going silent. An attachment is carried to the agent as image bytes over ACP or as a path where a preset names the flag, and one it cannot carry is refused in a sentence instead of dropped without a word. A workspace can be named by path from the operator's direct message, confirmed on the same signed card pairing uses; from a group, a path is refused and the workspace list is the answer.

## Specification

- [PRD](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/prd.md): problem, users, goals, non-goals, scope
- [FRD](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/frd.md): functional requirements by module, FR-ids
- [BRD](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/brd.md): market, positioning, business requirements
- [Design](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/design.md): architecture, interfaces, ACP and CLI driver contracts
- [ERD](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/erd.md): data model, integrity rules, retention
- [Session model](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/session-model.md): sessions as topics or threads, lifecycle, routing, housekeeping
- [Telegram integration](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/telegram-integration.md): Bot API 10.2 mapping
- [Security](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/security.md): threat model, mandatory controls, policy modes, and the pre-release checklist with a reason on every row that is not met
- [WhatsApp risk](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/whatsapp-risiko.md): what is known about bans, where each figure comes from, and when Cloud API is the right answer instead
- [Tech stack](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/techstack.md): choices with the alternatives that were rejected
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/CarakaDev/caraka/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md): phases, decision gates, and the field gates moved past the release
